content.text: Tests pass. The fix adds `br` (Brotli) and `compress` (`.Z`) encodings to the content-type mapping in `FileResponse`, so files like `test.html.br` and `test.html.Z` are served as `application/octet-stream` instead of being mistakenly identified as `text/html`.
